title: Oncology and cardiology PAs pended for missing diagnosis
scenario: After release 2026.11.1 almost every oncology and cardiology PA at Kestrel is pended for missing diagnosis although providers sent diagnoses, and some are expedited. A new validator warning appeared at the same time. Find the cause with the release diff, Bundles and engine logs, fix it and prove it with a regression test.
task: Replay the pipeline and compare with the baseline routing
Find the root cause; decide whether the validator warning matters
Fix it and add a regression test that fails on the released code
acceptance: Conditions use the ICD-10-CM system; routing back to baseline
Regression test passes on the fix and fails on the released mapper

practices.label: Week 3 Mon - FHIR R4 resources and coding systems
